name: Sky47 Karakoram-01
notes: Pakistan's largest AI-ready data centre, 8.5 MW phase 1 inaugurated 24 Jul 2026 at Capital Smart City's Silicon Village, Islamabad; datacentermap lists the campus at 50 MW; further capacity planned for Karachi and Lahore.

name: Islamabad IT Park Tier III Data Center
developer: PSEB / Ministry of IT & Telecom (Korean-funded; DC built by Korean Telecom)
notes: 720,000 sq ft Islamabad IT Park includes a Level-3 TIA-942 data center; inauguration was scheduled for 14 Aug 2025 after years of delay; completion status as of check date unverified.

name: Jazz Digital Park Data Center
notes: Pakistan's largest Tier III certified data center per aggregator, developed by Jazz with over USD 8M investment, 300+ racks scalable to 450, 3 MW power, located in Islamabad.

name: PTCL Data Center Islamabad
notes: PTCL Tier-III (TIA-942 Rated-3) data center at PTCL NOC/CDDT building, Sector H-9/1, Islamabad; also supplies PTCL Smart Cloud services.

name: OGDCL Data Center
notes: Enterprise TIA-942 Rated-III certified facility at OGDCL Building, Jinnah Avenue, Islamabad, supporting oil & gas operations.

name: Zong High Performance Computing Center / Cloud Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Zong operates a data center/colocation facility at CMPAK Complex, Kuri Road, Islamabad; a new Tier-III certified Cloud Intelligent Computing Center was inaugurated at HQ (reported 2025).

name: Nayatel Cloud Datacenter
notes: Nayatel Cloud Datacenter at Plot 23-B Block B, Media Town, Islamabad; ANSI/TIA-942-C Constructed Facility certification listed in the official TIA Online registry.

name: Multinet Islamabad Data Center
notes: Multinet colocation facility in the Blue Area, Islamabad; aggregator listing, capacity not published.

name: Data Vault Pakistan AI Data Center
notes: Pakistan's first AI-focused data centre, launched 26 Jun 2025 in Karachi; 100% solar-powered (first green AI DC in Pakistan), GPU-as-a-Service, sovereign infrastructure; capacity not disclosed.

name: Sky47 Karachi Data Center
notes: Sky47/Mari Energies' Karachi data center has entered preliminary construction phase targeting Tier III/IV sovereign hosting; part of the same program as Islamabad's Karakoram-01; capacity not disclosed.

name: PTCL Data Center Karachi
notes: PTCL's Tier-3+ data center at CTO Building, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi; hosts the Pakistan Internet Exchange (PKIX) powered by DE-CIX for local/international peering.

name: PTCL Commercial Data Center (Misrishah Exchange)
notes: PTCL Commercial Data Center at Misrishah Exchange, Khayaban-e-Muhafiz, DHA Phase-6, Karachi; ANSI/TIA-942-C Rated-3 certification per EPI certifications map (expiry 13-10-2027).

name: Multinet KDC01 Data Center
notes: Colocation facility at 1D-203, Sector 30, Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi; multi-provider connectivity per aggregator.

name: Multinet KDC02 Data Center
notes: Colocation facility at 17D-203, Sector 30, Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi; aggregator listing.

name: Chapal Data Center
notes: Colocation facility at G 19/2, Khayaban-e-Jami, Block 9, Clifton, Karachi; aggregator listing.

name: Supernet Data Center
notes: Colocation facility at Tower B, World Trade Center, Khayaban-e-Roomi, Block 5, Clifton, Karachi; aggregator listing.

name: Transworld Data Centre
notes: Transworld Associates (Karachi-based, operator of subsea cable systems and Google Verified Peering Provider) offers a Transworld Data Centre colocation facility; exact location/capacity not confirmed.

name: PTCL Data Center Lahore
notes: PTCL data center at Musa Street, Quaid-i-Azam Campus, Lahore with Tier 3+ capabilities per OCOLO listing.

name: Multinet LDC Data Center
notes: Multinet colocation facility at NTC Building, 6 Race Course Road, Lahore; aggregator listing.

name: Wateen Hosted Data Center
notes: Wateen hosted data center at 30 Aitchison Colony, Lahore; designed to Uptime Institute Tier III equivalent, scalable to Tier IV, per aggregator.

name: Sky47 Lahore Data Center
notes: Sky47 announced further capacity planned for Lahore as part of its national rollout after the Karakoram-01 inauguration; no site/capacity details published yet.

name: University of Turbat Data Center
notes: First phase of UoT's data center inaugurated in June 2023 by Balochistan Governor, alongside phase one of a 1MW solar project; connected to PERN 2 (Pakistan Education & Research Network); capacity not disclosed.
